items.title: THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ REMAINS CLOSED FOR ALL PRACTICAL PURPOSES.
items.content:
THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ REMAINS CLOSED FOR ALL PRACTICAL PURPOSES.Kpler (@Kpler)Hormuz traffic remains subdued

The Strait of Hormuz remained subdued on 7 August, with 8 confirmed crossings, down 33% day-on-day, while most vessels used the Iranian Unilateral Scheme. Bab el-Mandeb activity moved in the opposite direction, rising 18% to 26 confirmed crossings, including three dark transits. No additional vessel attacks were confirmed by the IMO. Kpler continues to monitor transit patterns, vessel risk profiles and routing behaviour across both strategic chokepoints.

Stay ahead of the market with  #Kpler Insight:  okt.to/Fvelas
